build_circos_sector: build a Circos chart sector with name, size, radian limits, and clockwise direction
create_track_in_sector: create a radial track inside a Circos sector with radius limits and padding ratio
plot_circos_text: plot rotated text labels at specified x and radius positions on a Circos sector
draw_circos_rect: draw an arc rectangle patch on a Circos sector with optional tooltip and radius limits
plot_raster_image: plot a raster image on a Circos sector with auto rotation and optional label
